##: Douyin live streaming companion (直播伴侣) from streamingtool.douyin.com.

The download button on the site 301s to the stale StreamingTool-11.3.3-x86.exe build (2025-12) and ignores the arch parameter; the current release is the x64 build from the same CDN path, verified against ByteDance.StreamingTool in winget-pkgs (same SHA-256).
ByteDance publishes no version API and no checksum, so checkver reads the version directory listing of the winget-pkgs manifest (maintained automatically) and autoupdate.hash is omitted.
The NSIS installer only wraps a single $_41_\app.7z; the installer script expands it into $dir, which yields the flat layout the app shell expects, with "直播伴侣.exe" at the root.
The app is x64 only; the 11.3.3 x86 build is the last 32-bit release and is a different version, so there is no 32bit architecture block.
description: Douyin live streaming companion (直播伴侣)
notes: The NSIS stubs ($PLUGINSDIR, $_41_, the versioned uninstaller) are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.
User data, cache and logs go to "$env:APPDATA\webcast_mate" and "$env:APPDATA\直播伴侣", so nothing needs to be persisted.
The bundled app_shell_updater stays enabled and may add its own versioned folders inside the Scoop app dir; run 'scoop install webcast-mate -f' to get back to the packaged build.

The vendor installer also registers drivers and services (virtual camera, capture); this manifest only unpacks the app, so features that depend on those drivers need a manual install of the official setup.
